subject: CAIQ: proof ledger, steward assignments, and temporary upload window
messages:
From: Jillian Hart <jillian.hart@northshorebank.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@northshorebank.com
Date: 2027-12-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: CAIQ sample set + preferred upload window

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick intro call. The audit team has asked for a compact sample set tied to the CAIQ controls we're evaluating (we're focusing on the runtime isolation, key management, and logging controls). Would Redwood be able to:  

- Provide a curated set (≈10–15 artifacts) that map to the control IDs we discussed
- Make them available via a temporary upload location (SCP or S3 presigned URL) with a 7-day TTL
- Include a short ledger (CSV) that lists the artifact, control mapping, owner, and retention class

If you can propose a steward roster and an upload window (ideally next week), we can lock procurement for a PO and share DocuSign for the NDA addendum.

Appreciate it — Jillian
Information Security | NorthShore Bank
--
Attachment: audit_scope.pdf (PDF, 78KB)

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jillian Hart <jillian.hart@northshorebank.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-12-05T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ sample set + preferred upload window

Jillian — thanks, noted. High level plan below; please confirm the scope (runtime isolation, key mgmt, logging) and the sample size (we'll aim for 12 artifacts).

Proposed plan (summary):
- Proof ledger: CSV mapping artifact -> CAIQ control -> internal owner -> short rationale -> TTL (we will provide)
- Upload method: temporary S3 bucket with presigned objects, TTL 7 days; will provide SCP fallback if you need inbound transfer
- Steward roster (proposed):
  * kimberly_park — control ownership & artifact packaging (PII/sensitive classification)
  * priyom_das — runtime telemetry and logs (samples + ingest playbook)
  * jonas_weber — crypto/key rotation artifacts and attestations
  * marissa_cole — overall QA and audit liaison
- Timeline: staging by Weds 2027-12-08, upload window Thurs 2027-12-09 09:00–17:00 PT (we can split into two sessions if you prefer)

I'll attach the initial ledger and upload instructions. If that window works, we'll kick the packaging sprint tomorrow and flag anything that needs legal/PO sign-off.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Programs | Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: proof_ledger_index.csv (CSV, 9KB); scp_upload_instructions.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jillian Hart <jillian.hart@northshorebank.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-12-05T11:26:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ sample set + preferred upload window

Jillian, Marissa — confirmed. I’ll take the packaging work and populate the ledger with artifact filenames and brief evidence pointers. A couple quick notes:

- For key management artifacts we’ll include rotation policies (redacted), KMS audit export snippets, and HSM attestation timestamp samples.
- For runtime isolation, we’ll include tenant-boundary diagrams, network ACL exports, and a small replay of a container start/stop trace (sanitized).
- For logs, we'll provide a 72-hour excerpt with redactions and a README describing log retention, sampling, and replay instructions.

I’ll aim to drop the first package and ledger by EOD 2027-12-07 so you have time to review before the staging window.

—Kimberly
Director, Compliance Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jillian Hart <jillian.hart@northshorebank.com>
Date: 2027-12-06T08:14:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ sample set + preferred upload window

Quick technical note on the upload and TTL:

- We'll create an S3 bucket in us-west-2 with a lifecycle rule that deletes objects 7 days after upload. Presigned URLs will be scoped to each object and expire after the 7-day window.
- For auditability, we'll enable object-level versioning and provide a short script that verifies checksums post-upload.
- If NorthShore needs outbound SCP, we can set up a temporary bastion with a one-time key; access_key file will be rotated after the transfer.

I’ll include the checksum script and TTL policy in the scp_upload_instructions.pdf attachment.

—Priyom
Senior Platform Engineer | Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: access_temp_keys.txt (TXT, 1KB)

Jillian — small update: Procurement asked that we include a short attest on data residency for the uploaded artifacts. I'm adding a single-line residency attestation to the ledger (column: residency_attestation).

Also, if you prefer the upload split into two sessions, we can do 9:00–12:00 PT (logs + telemetry) and 13:00–16:00 PT (crypto + policy docs). Please let me know which you prefer; otherwise we'll go with the single-block 09:00–17:00 option.

Thanks — Marissa

From: Jillian Hart <jillian.hart@northshorebank.com>

Subject: Re: CAIQ sample set + preferred upload window

Thanks all — that plan works. We prefer the split window: 9:00–12:00 PT for logs/telemetry and 13:00–16:00 PT for key material and policy artifacts. Procurement will circulate the PO and the minimal NDA addendum this afternoon; expect DocuSign from Legal.

Two minor asks:  
1) Can you include an abbreviated mapping row in the ledger for each artifact with the CAIQ control ID? (e.g., CM-2.1 -> runtime isolation trace)
2) Please mark any artifacts that include customer-identifying data; we'll treat those as PII and keep them in the audit vault only.

If you can confirm the final ledger by 2027-12-08 18:00 PT, we’ll publish the DocuSign and lock the courier.

Best,
Jillian
